name: Research: reader state and spaced-repetition review
outcome: Settled reader state and review: durable state in Postgres keyed by user_id + (tenant, project, document stem) with a cross-language unit; settings in a per-device kb_reader cookie; anonymous readers save nothing; 7 tables in one additive revision 0006_reader_state; server-side re-anchoring with block and orphan fallbacks; FSRS (py-fsrs, MIT) on the server with Again/Good ratings, a quiz's first attempt seeds its card, highlights opt-in; /app/reader/ routes + one pagehide beacon handler with per-user isolation and a readability re-check; 3 operator questions (anonymous state, highlights in review, notes on deletion)
